title: Deleting a category that parts use moves them to Uncategorized
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on matrix A, with a part in the inventory, part A, so the delete is one that today is blocked.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one range from $0.00 and Default on Markup % 50, pricing category A and no other.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Delete in the dialog.
  6. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists Delete.

Step 4:

  • The delete question opens.

Step 5:

  • The delete is not blocked: today's "Category cannot be deleted. It is used in one or more products." does not show.
  • The Categories list shows without category A.
  • In the inventory, part A's category reads Uncategorized.

Step 6:

  • Matrix A is still listed.
  • Matrix A's Status reads Inactive and its Categories cell shows "—".
